maintenance.title: We’ll be right back
maintenance.body: Covenant Path is briefly down for maintenance. Please check back in a little while.
maintenance.ownerBannerOn: Maintenance mode is ON — only you can see the app.
maintenance.cardHelp: When ON, everyone except you sees a maintenance screen and the database returns no member data to them — flip it the moment anything looks wrong, then turn it back off once it’s fixed.
maintenance.stateOn: The app is locked to everyone but you
maintenance.stateOff: The app is live for everyone
maintenance.messageLabel: Message shown on the maintenance screen

settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used across the app.

fillData.title: Fill missing data
fillData.intro: Some profile fields can’t be pulled by the automatic daily sync — the Church website only shares them during a brief signed-in session. A quick re-authorization fills them for the whole stake.
fillData.cellHint: Not available — click to see how to fill it
fillData.membersWithGaps: Members with at least one missing field: {{count}}
fillData.done: Done — {{filled}} of {{total}} members updated. Refreshing the table…
fillData.failed: The fill didn’t finish. Try again, or re-authorize and retry.
fillData.needsReauth: Your stored Church session has expired, so the data must be filled during a fresh sign-in. Re-authorize to continue — the fill starts automatically afterwards.
fillData.unfillable: Nothing left to fill. The remaining members have no Church profile record to read — their record was moved or transferred — so re-authorizing won't change it.
fillData.lastRunUnfillable: Last fill: {{when}} — nothing left to fill; the remaining members have no readable Church record.
fillData.notLeader: These fields need a stake leader: filling them takes a quick re-authorization with a stake leader’s Church account. Ask your stake leadership to open this panel and tap “Fill missing data now”.
fillData.noAccess: The account enrolled for sync doesn’t have access to member profiles in LCR, so these fields can’t be refreshed. A stake leader whose calling grants “Member Profiles” should enroll for sync.
fillData.allFilled: Every profile field is filled — nothing to do.
fillData.lastRunNone: Last fill: {{when}} — nothing could be updated, because the stored Church session had expired. Re-authorize and run it again.
fillData.statusError: Couldn’t load the data status — close and try again.

families.title: Families
families.intro: Part-member families — a household where one or more are members and one or more are not. Unbaptized members of record 9+ and unbaptized spouses come from the daily sync; a spouse the record only names (couple-form household name) is shown as a candidate to confirm with ward leadership.
families.emptyBody: Unbaptized members of record 9+ and unbaptized spouses appear here automatically after the next daily sync, once their household is in the Member Tools directory. A spouse from the LCR part-member report can also be added by hand.
families.onDateNoInvestigator: On Date needs the person being taught first — add them as an investigator in Being Taught (Golden Hour), in this unit, then set On Date.
families.onDateNoGoalDate: The investigator has no planned baptism date yet — set one in Being Taught first, then set On Date.
families.rollupTitle: Monthly rollup for the stake presidency
families.rollupNote: Unit totals only — no names. Shared with the stake presidency each month.
families.rollupGap: Member-present lessons, member referrals, and next month's baptismal goal are mission KPIs — they aren't in the sync data, so they aren't shown here. Track them in the mission's monthly report, not from this table.
families.addHelp: For an unbaptized spouse (List B) or a child the LCR lists missed. The member's name should match the directory so the family links to their record.
families.addRequired: Fill in the member, the non-member, and the unit.
families.basisConfirmed: Confirmed — unbaptized spouse in the home
families.basisCandidate: Candidate — spouse named on the household record; confirm with ward leadership
